answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 63184 Country: India Title: Ruling on water heated by the solar heater Question: Can hot water solar heater be used? Is it permissible by Shariah? Answer ID: 63184 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 289/411/SN=05/1437) According to Shariah, it is lawful to use the solar heater. And wudhu and ghusl done with water heated by the solar heater shall be valid without any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
